newsitem.title: CHINA: China state grain purchases 77 pct of target.
newsitem.headline: China state grain purchases 77 pct of target.

text.p: Chinese state grain buyers have bought 69.68 million tonnes of grain so far this year, accounting for 77.4 percent of their state-set purchase target for 1996, the China Business Daily said on Friday.

Of the total grain purchases, that bought at state-set prices accounted for 42.72 million tonnes, achieving 85.4 percent of the target for the year, the newspaper said, quoting December 15 statistics.
A number of provinces had already completed their state buying quotas while others had achieved more than 90 percent of the targets, it said.
"All kinds of grain purchasing are now proceeding at full speed," it said but gave no details.
Every year China buys a portion of the grain crop for sale and distribution in urban areas and to state enterprises.
